_about: 胸部X線写真の匠（chest-xray-master）の採点基準と原典の照合表。2026-11-17。採点の項目・点・基準値を変えるときはここを先に直し、原典の頁を確認する。check: text＝原典のテキスト（OCRでない）で照合、none＝原典に記載がないゲーム上の項目

EUR16260.title: European Guidelines on Quality Criteria for Diagnostic Radiographic Images, EUR 16260 EN (European Commission, June 1996)
EUR16260.note: Chest (Lungs and Heart), PA projection, 1.1 Image criteria。pdf_page は PDF の通し頁。

rot.quote: Symmetrical reproduction of the thorax as shown by central position of the spinous process between the medial ends of the clavicles

center.note: 原典に直接の記載はない。背骨をパネルの左右中心に置くことはゲームの設計上の項目

coverage.quote: Reproduction of the whole rib cage above the diaphragm / Visually sharp reproduction of: … (c) the diaphragm and lateral costo-phrenic angles

scapula.quote: Medial border of the scapulae to be outside the lung fields

inspiration.quote: Performed at full inspiration (as assessed by the position of the ribs above the diaphragm — either 6 anteriorly or 10 posteriorly) and with suspended respiration

motion.quote: with suspended respiration / Visually sharp reproduction of the vascular pattern in the whole lung, particularly the peripheral vessels
